root.string: float llSin(float theta) Sine of an angle given in radians.
float llCos(float theta) Cosine of an angle given in radians.
float llTan(float theta) Tangent of an angle given in radians.
float llAtan2(float y, float x) Angle in radians of the point (x, y) measured from the positive x axis; the signs of both arguments pick the quadrant.
float llSqrt(float val) Square root of val. A negative val gives 0 and raises a math error in the script.
float llPow(float base, float exponent) base raised to exponent. A result that is not a real number gives 0 and raises a math error in the script.
integer llAbs(integer val) Absolute value of an integer.
float llFabs(float val) Absolute value of a float.
float llFrand(float mag) Random float from 0 up to mag. The mag end is never returned. A negative mag gives values between mag and 0 instead.
integer llFloor(float val) Largest integer that is not greater than val (rounds toward negative infinity).
integer llCeil(float val) Smallest integer that is not less than val (rounds toward positive infinity).
integer llRound(float val) val rounded to the closest integer.
float llVecMag(vector v) Length of vector v.
vector llVecNorm(vector v) Vector with the same direction as v and a length of 1.
float llVecDist(vector v1, vector v2) Straight-line distance between the points v1 and v2.
vector llRot2Euler(rotation q) Converts rotation q to Euler angles in radians, returned as a vector (x = roll, y = pitch, z = yaw).
rotation llEuler2Rot(vector v) Converts Euler angles v (radians, x = roll, y = pitch, z = yaw) to a rotation.
rotation llAxes2Rot(vector fwd, vector left, vector up) Builds the rotation whose local forward, left and up axes point along the three given vectors.
vector llRot2Fwd(rotation q) The forward (+X) axis of rotation q, as a unit vector.
vector llRot2Left(rotation q) The left (+Y) axis of rotation q, as a unit vector.
vector llRot2Up(rotation q) The up (+Z) axis of rotation q, as a unit vector.
rotation llRotBetween(vector v1, vector v2) Smallest rotation that turns the direction of v1 onto the direction of v2.
llWhisper(integer channel, string msg) Speaks msg on channel at whisper volume (heard within 10 m).
llSay(integer channel, string msg) Speaks msg on channel at normal volume (heard within 20 m).
llShout(integer channel, string msg) Speaks msg on channel at shout volume (heard within 100 m).

integer llListen(integer channel, string name, key id, string msg) Starts listening for chat on channel and returns a handle. name, id and msg act as filters, and an empty value for any of them matches everything. The handle is used with llListenControl and llListenRemove.
llListenControl(integer number, integer active) Pauses (active = FALSE) or resumes (active = TRUE) the listener with handle number.
llListenRemove(integer number) Cancels the listener with handle number.

llSensor(string name, key id, integer type, float range, float arc) Scans once for objects or avatars. name and id filter the results (empty, or NULL_KEY for id, matches anything), type is a mix of AGENT, ACTIVE, PASSIVE and SCRIPTED, range is in meters and arc is the half-angle in radians around the object's forward axis. Results arrive in a sensor event, or no_sensor if nothing matched.
llSensorRepeat(string name, key id, integer type, float range, float arc, float rate) Same scan as llSensor, but repeated every rate seconds until llSensorRemove is called.
llSensorRemove() Stops the repeating scan started by llSensorRepeat.
string llDetectedName(integer number) Name of the detected item at index number in the current event. Empty string if the index is out of range.
key llDetectedKey(integer number) UUID of the detected item at index number in the current event. NULL_KEY if the index is out of range.
key llDetectedOwner(integer number) UUID of the owner of the detected item at index number. NULL_KEY if the index is out of range.
integer llDetectedType(integer number) Bit mask describing the detected item at index number (AGENT, ACTIVE, PASSIVE and/or SCRIPTED). 0 if the index is out of range.
vector llDetectedPos(integer number) Position of the detected item at index number. <0,0,0> if the index is out of range.
vector llDetectedVel(integer number) Velocity of the detected item at index number. <0,0,0> if the index is out of range.
vector llDetectedGrab(integer number) For touch events, the offset of the grab point for the toucher at index number. <0,0,0> if the index is out of range.
rotation llDetectedRot(integer number) Rotation of the detected item at index number. <0,0,0,1> if the index is out of range.
integer llDetectedGroup(integer number) TRUE when the detected item at index number is in the same group as the object's owner.
integer llDetectedLinkNumber(integer number) Link number of the prim that was touched or collided with. Only meaningful in touch and collision events.
llDie() Removes the whole object from the region.
float llGround(vector offset) Terrain height at the object's position shifted by offset.
float llCloud(vector offset) Cloud density at the object's position shifted by offset.
vector llWind(vector offset) Wind velocity at the object's position shifted by offset.

llSetStatus(integer status, integer value) Turns object status flags on or off. status can combine STATUS_PHYSICS, STATUS_PHANTOM, STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB and the STATUS_ROTATE_* axis locks; value is TRUE to set them or FALSE to clear them.
integer llGetStatus(integer status) Tells whether the given status flag is set (STATUS_PHYSICS, STATUS_PHANTOM, STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB, STATUS_ROTATE_X/Y/Z).
llSetScale(vector scale) Resizes the prim to scale (meters per axis).
vector llGetScale() Size of the prim in meters per axis.
llSetColor(vector color, integer face) Tints one face of the prim, or every face when face is ALL_SIDES.
float llGetAlpha(integer face) Opacity of the given face, from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (opaque).
llSetAlpha(float alpha, integer face) Sets the opacity of one face, or every face when face is ALL_SIDES.
vector llGetColor(integer face) Tint color of the given face as an RGB vector.
llSetTexture(string texture, integer face) Applies a texture to one face, or to every face when face is ALL_SIDES. texture is an inventory name or a UUID.
llScaleTexture(float u, float v, integer face) Sets the horizontal (u) and vertical (v) texture repeats on one face, or on every face for ALL_SIDES.
llOffsetTexture(float u, float v, integer face) Sets the horizontal (u) and vertical (v) texture offset on one face, or on every face for ALL_SIDES.
llRotateTexture(float rotation, integer face) Rotates the texture on one face by rotation radians, or on every face for ALL_SIDES.
string llGetTexture(integer face) Texture on the given face. The result is the item name when that texture is in the prim's inventory, and the UUID string otherwise.
llSetPos(vector pos) Moves the prim to pos without physics. In a child prim pos is relative to the root. Does nothing useful for physical objects.
vector llGetPos() Position of the prim in region coordinates.
vector llGetLocalPos() Position of the prim relative to the root prim of its link set.
llSetRot(rotation rot) Sets the rotation of the object or, for a child prim, its rotation relative to the root.
rotation llGetRot() Rotation of the prim in region coordinates.
rotation llGetLocalRot() Rotation of the prim relative to the root prim of its link set.
llSetForce(vector force, integer local) Sets a continuous force on a physical object. When local is TRUE the force is in the object's own axes, otherwise in region axes.
vector llGetForce() Continuous force currently set on a physical object.

integer llTarget(vector position, float range) Registers a position target: an area of radius range around position. Returns a handle. at_target or not_at_target events report whether the object is inside it.
llTargetRemove(integer number) Cancels the position target with handle number.

integer llRotTarget(rotation rot, float error) Registers a rotation target: orientations within error radians of rot. Returns a handle. at_rot_target or not_at_rot_target events report whether the object matches it.
llRotTargetRemove(integer number) Cancels the rotation target with handle number.
llMoveToTarget(vector target, float tau) Pulls a physical object toward target, settling there with critical damping over about tau seconds.
llStopMoveToTarget() Cancels the pull started by llMoveToTarget.
llApplyImpulse(vector force, integer local) Gives a physical object a one-time push. When local is TRUE the push is in the object's own axes, otherwise in region axes.
llApplyRotationalImpulse(vector force, integer local) Gives a physical object a one-time spin. When local is TRUE the axes are the object's own, otherwise region axes.
llSetTorque(vector torque, integer local) Sets a continuous turning force on a physical object. When local is TRUE the axes are the object's own, otherwise region axes.
vector llGetTorque() Continuous turning force currently set on a physical object.

llSetForceAndTorque(vector force, vector torque, integer local) Sets both the continuous force and the continuous torque on a physical object. When local is TRUE the axes are the object's own, otherwise region axes.
vector llGetVel() Current velocity of the object in region coordinates.
vector llGetAccel() Current acceleration of the object in region coordinates.
vector llGetOmega() Current angular velocity of the object, in radians per second.
float llGetTimeOfDay() Seconds elapsed since the grid's day began, but never more than the time since the region started.
float llGetWallclock() Seconds elapsed since midnight in the US Pacific time zone.
float llGetTime() Seconds on the script's timer. It starts at region start or script reset, and returns to zero when llResetTime or llGetAndResetTime is called.
llResetTime() Sets the script's timer back to zero.
float llGetAndResetTime() Returns the script's timer in seconds and sets it back to zero in one step.
llSound(string sound, float volume, integer queue, integer loop) Plays a sound at the given volume. queue says whether it waits for the current sound, and loop whether it repeats.
llPlaySound(string sound, float volume) Plays a sound once from the prim itself, at volume 0.0 to 1.0.
llLoopSound(string sound, float volume) Plays a sound from the prim in a loop, at volume 0.0 to 1.0.
llLoopSoundMaster(string sound, float volume) Loops a sound from the prim at volume 0.0 to 1.0 and marks it as the timing source that slave sounds follow.
llLoopSoundSlave(string sound, float volume) Loops a sound from the prim at volume 0.0 to 1.0, kept in step with the loudest nearby master loop.
llPlaySoundSlave(string sound, float volume) Plays a sound once from the prim at volume 0.0 to 1.0, starting on the next cycle of the loudest nearby master loop.
llTriggerSound(string sound, float volume) Plays a sound once at volume 0.0 to 1.0 from where the object is now; the sound does not follow the object.
llStopSound() Stops the sound that is playing from the prim.
llPreloadSound(string sound) Asks viewers near the object to download the sound so it plays without delay later.
string llGetSubString(string src, integer start, integer end) Part of src from index start to index end, both included. Negative indexes count back from the end of the string.
string llDeleteSubString(string src, integer start, integer end) Copy of src with the characters from index start to index end, both included, cut out. Negative indexes count back from the end.
string llInsertString(string dst, integer position, string src) Copy of dst with src inserted so that it begins at index position.
string llToUpper(string src) src with every letter converted to upper case.
string llToLower(string src) src with every letter converted to lower case.
llGiveMoney(key destination, integer amount) Pays amount L$ from the object owner's balance to destination. Needs the owner's debit permission.

llMakeExplosion(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset) Legacy one-call particle effect: a burst of particles spreading out in a round shape.

llMakeFountain(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, integer bounce, string texture, vector offset, float bounce_offset) Legacy one-call particle effect: particles shot upward in a fountain that can bounce off the ground.
llMakeSmoke(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset) Legacy one-call particle effect: rising smoke-like particles.
llMakeFire(integer particles, float scale, float vel, float lifetime, float arc, string texture, vector offset) Legacy one-call particle effect: flame-like particles.

llRezObject(string inventory, vector pos, vector vel, rotation rot, integer param) Creates a copy of an inventory object at pos with starting velocity vel and rotation rot. param is handed to the new object's scripts as its start parameter.

llLookAt(vector target, float strength, float damping) Turns the object, with the given strength and damping, so its +Z axis points toward target while its +X axis is kept from rising above the horizon.
llStopLookAt() Cancels llLookAt or llRotLookAt.
llSetTimerEvent(float sec) Makes the timer event fire every sec seconds. 0.0 turns the timer off.
llSleep(float sec) Pauses the script for sec seconds.
float llGetMass() Mass of the object the script is in, in Lindograms (Lg).

llCollisionFilter(string name, key id, integer accept) Restricts which collisions raise events. With accept = TRUE only objects matching name and/or id count; with FALSE objects matching them are ignored. Empty values are not used as filters.

llTakeControls(integer controls, integer accept, integer pass_on) Lets the script receive the keyboard and mouse input of the avatar that granted control permission. controls selects the inputs, accept chooses whether they are taken, and pass_on whether the input also continues to the avatar.
llReleaseControls() Gives back the inputs taken with llTakeControls.
llAttachToAvatar(integer attach_point) Attaches the object at attach_point to the avatar that granted the attach permission.
llDetachFromAvatar() Detaches the object from the avatar wearing it.
llTakeCamera(key avatar) Hands the camera of avatar over to this object. Deprecated.
llReleaseCamera(key avatar) Returns the camera of avatar to the avatar. Deprecated.
key llGetOwner() UUID of the avatar that owns the object.
llInstantMessage(key user, string message) Sends message as an instant message to user.
llEmail(string address, string subject, string message) Sends an email with the given subject and message to address.
llGetNextEmail(string address, string subject) Asks for the next queued email for the object, optionally narrowed by sender address and subject. Delivered through the email event.
key llGetKey() UUID of the prim containing the script.
llSetBuoyancy(float buoyancy) Sets how strongly a physical object floats: 0 turns it off, below 1.0 sinks, 1.0 hovers, above 1.0 rises.
llSetHoverHeight(float height, integer water, float tau) Makes a physical object settle at height above the ground (or above water when water is TRUE) over about tau seconds.
llStopHover() Cancels the hover set by llSetHoverHeight.
llMinEventDelay(float delay) Sets the shortest allowed gap, in seconds, between two events delivered to the script.
llSoundPreload(string sound) Asks viewers near the object to download the sound so it plays without delay later.
llRotLookAt(rotation target, float strength, float damping) Turns the object, with the given strength and damping, so its forward axis points along target.
integer llStringLength(string str) Number of characters in str.
llStartAnimation(string anim) Starts the animation named anim on the avatar that granted the trigger-animation permission.
llStopAnimation(string anim) Stops the animation named anim on the avatar that granted the trigger-animation permission.
llPointAt(vector pos) Makes the owner's avatar point toward pos.
llStopPointAt() Stops the owner's avatar pointing.
llTargetOmega(vector axis, float spinrate, float gain) Makes the object spin about axis at spinrate radians per second, with gain setting how forcefully.
integer llGetStartParameter() The integer passed to this script when its object was rezzed (0 if none was given).
llGodLikeRezObject(key inventory, vector pos) Rezzes an object directly from its asset UUID. Works only when the owner has administrator powers.
llRequestPermissions(key agent, integer perm) Asks agent to grant the PERMISSION_* flags in perm. The answer arrives in the run_time_permissions event.
key llGetPermissionsKey() UUID of the avatar whose grant is currently held by the script.
integer llGetPermissions() Bit field of the PERMISSION_* flags currently granted to the script.
integer llGetLinkNumber() Link number of the prim holding the script: 0 for an unlinked prim, 1 for the root, 2 and up for children.
llSetLinkColor(integer linknumber, vector color, integer face) Tints one face of the prim at linknumber (a number or a LINK_* constant).
llCreateLink(key target, integer parent) Links this object to target. Needs the change-links permission. With parent = TRUE this object becomes the root, otherwise target does.
llBreakLink(integer linknum) Unlinks the prim at link number linknum. Needs the change-links permission.
llBreakAllLinks() Unlinks every prim in the link set. Needs the change-links permission.
key llGetLinkKey(integer linknumber) UUID of the prim at link number linknumber.
string llGetLinkName(integer linknumber) Name of the prim at link number linknumber.
integer llGetInventoryNumber(integer type) How many inventory items of the given INVENTORY_* type the prim holds.
string llGetInventoryName(integer type, integer number) Name of inventory item number of the given INVENTORY_* type (counted from 0).
llSetScriptState(string name, integer run) Starts (run = TRUE) or stops (run = FALSE) the script named name in this prim.
float llGetEnergy() Energy stored in the object, given as a percentage of its maximum.
llGiveInventory(key destination, string inventory) Copies the named inventory item to destination (an avatar or an object).
llRemoveInventory(string item) Deletes the named item from the prim's inventory.
llSetText(string text, vector color, float alpha) Shows floating text above the prim in the given color, with alpha as its opacity.
float llWater(vector offset) Water surface height at the object's position shifted by offset.
llPassTouches(integer pass) When pass is TRUE, touch events that reach this prim are also sent on to the parent prim.
key llRequestAgentData(key id, integer data) Asks for the DATA_* information about avatar id. The reply comes back in the dataserver event.
key llRequestInventoryData(string name) Asks for data about the named inventory item. The reply comes back in the dataserver event.
llSetDamage(float damage) Sets how much damage the object does when it hits an avatar.
llTeleportAgentHome(key id) Sends avatar id to their home location at once, with no confirmation. Works only on land the owner controls.
llModifyLand(integer action, integer brush) Reshapes terrain with the given action (LAND_*) and brush size (LAND_SMALL_BRUSH and so on).
llCollisionSound(string impact_sound, float impact_volume) Replaces the built-in collision sounds with impact_sound, played at impact_volume. Calling it also turns the default sounds off.
llCollisionSprite(string impact_sprite) Replaces the built-in collision particle sprite with impact_sprite. An empty string only turns the default sprite off.
string llGetAnimation(key id) Name of the movement animation (walk, run, stand and so on) that avatar id is playing now.
llResetScript() Restarts this script from its beginning: variables are cleared and the default state is entered.

llMessageLinked(integer linknum, integer num, string str, key id) Sends a message to the scripts of the prims chosen by linknum (a number or a LINK_* constant). Each receiving script gets a link_message event carrying num, str and id.

llPushObject(key id, vector impulse, vector ang_impulse, integer local) Pushes the object or avatar id with a linear impulse and an angular impulse. local selects whether the impulses use the target's own axes or region axes.
llPassCollisions(integer pass) When pass is TRUE, collision events that reach this prim are also sent on to the parent prim. Off by default.
string llGetScriptName() Name of the script that calls this function.
integer llGetNumberOfSides() How many faces the prim has.
rotation llAxisAngle2Rot(vector axis, float angle) Rotation of angle radians around axis.
vector llRot2Axis(rotation rot) Axis of the rotation rot, as a unit vector.
float llRot2Angle(rotation rot) Angle of the rotation rot, in radians.
float llAcos(float val) Angle in radians whose cosine is val. Needs val from -1 to 1.
float llAsin(float val) Angle in radians whose sine is val. Needs val from -1 to 1.
float llAngleBetween(rotation a, rotation b) Size in radians of the turn that takes rotation a to rotation b.
key llGetInventoryKey(string name) Asset UUID of the inventory item called name.
llAllowInventoryDrop(integer add) When add is TRUE, anyone can drop items into the prim's inventory even without modify rights. FALSE restores the normal rule.
vector llGetSunDirection() Unit vector pointing from the region toward the sun.
vector llGetTextureOffset(integer face) Texture offset of face, in the x and y fields of a vector.
vector llGetTextureScale(integer side) Texture repeats of side, in the x and y fields of a vector.
float llGetTextureRot(integer side) Texture rotation of side, in radians.
integer llSubStringIndex(string source, string pattern) Position in source where pattern first occurs, counting from 0, or -1 when it does not occur.
key llGetOwnerKey(key id) UUID of the owner of the object id.
vector llGetCenterOfMass() Center of mass of the prim, in region coordinates. When called from the root prim it gives the center of mass of the whole link set.

list llListSort(list src, integer stride, integer ascending) Sorts src and returns it. The list is treated as groups of stride entries, ordered by the first entry of each group, ascending when ascending is TRUE. Ordering depends on the entries' types.
integer llGetListLength(list src) Number of entries in the list.
integer llList2Integer(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as an integer.
float llList2Float(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as a float.
string llList2String(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as a string.
key llList2Key(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as a key.
vector llList2Vector(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as a vector.
rotation llList2Rot(list src, integer index) Entry at index of the list, as a rotation.
list llList2List(list src, integer start, integer end) Sub-list of src from index start to index end, both included.
list llDeleteSubList(list src, integer start, integer end) Copy of src with the entries from index start to index end, both included, cut out.

integer llGetListEntryType(list src, integer index) Type of the entry at index: TYPE_INTEGER, TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_STRING, TYPE_KEY, TYPE_VECTOR or TYPE_ROTATION, or TYPE_INVALID when index is outside the list.
string llList2CSV(list src) Joins the list entries into one string separated by commas.
list llCSV2List(string src) Splits a comma-separated string into a list.
list llListRandomize(list src, integer stride) Shuffles src and returns it. The list is treated as groups of stride entries, and whole groups are reordered.
list llList2ListStrided(list src, integer start, integer end, integer stride) Takes every stride-th entry of src between index start and index end (both included) and returns them as a list.
vector llGetRegionCorner() Global coordinates, in meters, of the region's south-west corner for the region holding the object.
list llListInsertList(list dest, list src, integer start) Copy of dest with the entries of src inserted so that they begin at index start.
integer llListFindList(list src, list test) Index where the list test first appears as a run inside src, or -1 when it does not.
string llGetObjectName() Name of the prim holding the script.
llSetObjectName(string name) Renames the prim to name.
string llGetDate() Today's date in UTC, written YYYY-MM-DD.
integer llEdgeOfWorld(vector pos, vector dir) TRUE when walking from pos in direction dir leads off the edge of the grid, with no region next door.

integer llGetAgentInfo(key id) Bit field of AGENT_* flags for avatar id: AGENT_FLYING, AGENT_ATTACHMENTS, AGENT_SCRIPTED, AGENT_SITTING, AGENT_ON_OBJECT, AGENT_MOUSELOOK, AGENT_AWAY, AGENT_BUSY, AGENT_TYPING, AGENT_CROUCHING, AGENT_ALWAYS_RUN, AGENT_WALKING and/or AGENT_IN_AIR.
llAdjustSoundVolume(float volume) Changes the volume (0.0 to 1.0) of the sound attached to the prim.
llSetSoundQueueing(integer queue) When queue is TRUE, a new attached sound waits for the current one to end. When FALSE (the default), it replaces it.
llSetSoundRadius(float radius) Sets a distance beyond which sounds from this object, attached or triggered, cannot be heard.
string llKey2Name(key id) Name of the prim or avatar with UUID id. Gives an empty string unless that item is in this region.

llSetTextureAnim(integer mode, integer face, integer sizex, integer sizey, float start, float length, float rate) Starts, changes or stops an animation of the texture on one face or all faces (mode holds ANIM_ON and the other ANIM_* flags). sizex and sizey give the frame grid, start and length pick the frames, rate is the speed.

llTriggerSoundLimited(string sound, float volume, vector top_north_east, vector bottom_south_west) Plays a sound once at volume 0.0 to 1.0 from the object's position, audible only inside the box between the corners top_north_east and bottom_south_west.
llEjectFromLand(key avatar) Removes avatar from the parcel the object is on.

list llParseString2List(string src, list separators, list spacers) Splits src into a list. Text matching an entry of separators is dropped, text matching an entry of spacers is kept as its own item. Each list may hold at most 8 strings.
integer llOverMyLand(key id) TRUE when the avatar or object id is standing on or above land owned by the script's owner.
key llGetLandOwnerAt(vector pos) UUID of the owner of the parcel at pos. NULL_KEY when the parcel is not owned by an individual or group.
key llGetNotecardLine(string name, integer line) Asks for line number line of the notecard name. The text comes back in the dataserver event, and the return value identifies the request.
vector llGetAgentSize(key id) Size of the bounding box of avatar id, or ZERO_VECTOR when that avatar is not in the region.
integer llSameGroup(key id) TRUE when avatar id is present in this region and has the same active group as the object.
key llUnSit(key id) Makes avatar id stand up, if that avatar sits on this object or is on land owned by the object's owner.
vector llGroundSlope(vector offset) Slope of the terrain at the object's position shifted by offset.
vector llGroundNormal(vector offset) Surface normal of the terrain at the object's position shifted by offset.
vector llGroundCountour(vector offset) Direction of the terrain's contour line at the object's position shifted by offset.
integer llGetAttached() Attachment point the object is worn on, or 0 when it is not attached.
integer llGetFreeMemory() Bytes of script memory still available.
string llGetRegionName() Name of the region the object is in.
float llGetRegionTimeDilation() Region time dilation: 1.0 when the simulation runs at full speed, lower values when it falls behind.
float llGetRegionFPS() Average simulation frames per second of the region.
llParticleSystem(list rules) Starts a particle emitter described by rules, a list of PSYS_* parameter and value pairs. An empty list turns the emitter off.

llGroundRepel(float height, integer water, float tau) Keeps a physical object about height above the ground (or above the higher of ground and water when water is TRUE), easing over about tau seconds. Takes effect only within half of height of that level.
llGiveInventoryList(key target, string folder, list inventory) Copies the inventory items named in inventory into a new folder called folder in the inventory of target.
llSetVehicleType(integer type) Turns the object into a vehicle of one of the preset VEHICLE_TYPE_* kinds.
llSetVehicleFloatParam(integer param, float value) Sets one float vehicle parameter (VEHICLE_* name) to value.
llSetVehicleVectorParam(integer param, vector vec) Sets one vector vehicle parameter (VEHICLE_* name) to vec.
llSetVehicleVectorParam(integer param, rotation rot) Sets one rotation vehicle parameter (VEHICLE_* name) to rot.
llSetVehicleFlags(integer flags) Turns on the VEHICLE_FLAG_* bits given in flags and leaves other flags as they are.
llRemoveVehicleFlags(integer flags) Turns off the VEHICLE_FLAG_* bits given in flags and leaves other flags as they are.
llSitTarget(vector offset, rotation rot) Sets where a sitting avatar is placed on the prim, as an offset and rotation. An offset of <0,0,0> clears the sit target.
key llAvatarOnSitTarget() UUID of the avatar sitting on the sit target, or NULL_KEY when nobody is.
llAddToLandPassList(key avatar, float hours) Gives avatar a pass for the parcel for hours hours. 0 hours makes the pass permanent.
llSetTouchText(string text) Changes the label of the touch entry in the object's pie menu to text.
llSetSitText(string text) Changes the label of the sit entry in the object's pie menu to text.
llSetCameraEyeOffset(vector offset) Sets where the camera sits, relative to the object, for avatars seated on it.
llSetCameraAtOffset(vector offset) Sets the point the camera looks at, relative to the object, for avatars seated on it.
string llDumpList2String(list src, string separator) Joins the list entries into one string with separator between them.
integer llScriptDanger(vector pos) TRUE when scripts at pos could be harmful or restricted there: public land, sandbox land, land where not everyone can build, or land that blocks outside scripts.

llDialog(key avatar, string message, list buttons, integer chat_channel Shows avatar a dialog with message and at most 12 buttons. When a button is clicked, the avatar speaks its label on chat_channel.

llVolumeDetect(integer detect) With detect TRUE the object behaves like a phantom volume that still raises collision_start and collision_end events when others enter and leave it. Set it on the root prim.
llResetOtherScript(string name) Restarts the script called name in this prim.
integer llGetScriptState(string name) TRUE while the script called name is running.
llSetRemoteScriptAccessPin(integer pin) Sets the pin that lets other objects load scripts into this prim with llRemoteLoadScriptPin. A pin of 0 switches that off.

llRemoteLoadScriptPin(key target, string name, integer pin, integer running, integer start_param) Copies the script called name into target, optionally starting it with start_param when running is TRUE. Succeeds only if pin matches the target's pin, the target is in this region and the owner may modify it.
llOpenRemoteDataChannel() Opens an XML-RPC channel for this object. A remote_data event reports the channel once it is ready.

key llSendRemoteData(key channel, string dest, integer idata, string sdata) Posts an XML-RPC request to dest over channel, carrying idata and sdata. The returned key identifies the request in later remote_data events.
llRemoteDataReply(key channel, key message_id, string sdata, integer idata) Answers the XML-RPC request message_id on channel with sdata and idata.
llCloseRemoteDataChannel(key channel) Closes the XML-RPC channel.
string llMD5String(string src, integer nonce) MD5 hash of src plus nonce, as 32 hexadecimal characters.
llSetPrimitiveParams(list rules) Changes several prim properties in one call; rules is a list of PRIM_* parameters, each followed by its values.
string llStringToBase64(string str) Base64 encoding of str.
string llBase64ToString(string str) Decodes a Base64 string to text. Bytes that cannot be shown are replaced with spaces.
string llXorBase64Strings(string s1, string s2) Deprecated; use llXorBase64StringsCorrect. XORs two Base64 strings in a way that is kept only for old scripts, repeating s2 when it is shorter than s1.
float llLog10(float val) Base-10 logarithm of val. Returns 0 when val is 0 or negative.
float llLog(float val) Natural logarithm of val. Returns 0 when val is 0 or negative.
list llGetAnimationList(key id) List of UUIDs of the animations avatar id is playing.
llSetParcelMusicURL(string url) Sets the audio stream address for the parcel the object is on.
string llGetParcelMusicURL() Audio stream address of the parcel the object is on.
vector llGetRootPosition() Position of the root prim of this object, in region coordinates.
rotation llGetRootRotation() Rotation of the root prim of this object, in region coordinates.
string llGetObjectDesc() Description text of the prim.
llSetObjectDesc(string name) Sets the description text of the prim.
key llGetCreator() UUID of the avatar who made the prim.
string llGetTimestamp() Current UTC date and time in the form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.ff..fZ.
llSetLinkAlpha(integer linknumber, float alpha, integer face) Sets the opacity of one face of the prim at linknumber.
integer llGetNumberOfPrims() Number of prims in the link set containing the script.
key llGetNumberOfNotecardLines(string name) Asks for the number of lines in the notecard name. The count arrives in the dataserver event as text; the return value identifies the request.
list llGetBoundingBox(key object) Bounding box of the object (all linked prims), relative to its root, as the list [min corner, max corner].
vector llGetGeometricCenter() Geometric center of the link set containing the script.
list llGetPrimitiveParams(list params) Reads prim properties: params lists the PRIM_* values wanted, and their current settings come back as a list.
string llIntegerToBase64(integer number) Base64 encoding of number as four bytes, most significant byte first.
integer llBase64ToInteger(string str) Reads the first four bytes of the decoded Base64 string str as a big-endian integer.
float llGetGMTclock() Seconds since midnight GMT.
string llGetSimulatorHostname() Host name of the machine running this region.
llSetLocalRot(rotation rot) Sets the orientation of a child prim relative to its root prim.

list llParseStringKeepNulls(string src, list separators, list spacers) Like llParseString2List, but empty pieces between consecutive separators stay in the result. Each of separators and spacers may hold at most 8 strings.

llRezAtRoot(string inventory, vector pos, vector vel, rotation rot, integer param) Creates a copy of an inventory object so that its root prim is at pos, with velocity vel and rotation rot. param becomes the new object's start parameter.
integer llGetObjectPermMask(integer mask) Permission mask of the given kind (MASK_*) for the root prim of this object.
llSetObjectPermMask(integer mask, integer value) Changes the given kind of permission mask on the root prim of this object. Needs administrator powers.
integer llGetInventoryPermMask(string item, integer mask) Permission mask of the given kind (MASK_*) for the inventory item.
llSetInventoryPermMask(string item, integer mask, integer value) Changes the given kind of permission mask on an inventory item. Needs administrator powers.
key llGetInventoryCreator(string item) UUID of the avatar who made the inventory item.
llOwnerSay(string msg) Sends msg in chat to the owner only. The owner must be in this region.
key llRequestSimulatorData(string simulator, integer data) Asks for information (a DATA_* kind) about the region called simulator. The reply comes back in the dataserver event.
llForceMouselook(integer mouselook) When mouselook is TRUE, avatars that sit on the prim are switched into mouselook view.
float llGetObjectMass(key id) Mass in kilograms of the avatar or object id in this region.
list llListReplaceList(list dest, list src, integer start, integer end) Copy of dest with entries start to end removed and the entries of src put in at start.
llLoadURL(key avatar, string message, string url) Offers avatar a dialog with message asking whether to open url. Accepting opens the page in their browser.
llParcelMediaCommandList(list command) Controls the parcel's media playback with a list of PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* commands and their arguments.
list llParcelMediaQuery(list query) Reads parcel media settings; query lists the PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_* values wanted and the answers come back as a list.
integer llModPow(integer a, integer b, integer c) Computes (a ** b) mod c. The exponent b is capped at 0xFFFF.
integer llGetInventoryType(string name) Kind of the inventory item name (an INVENTORY_* value), or INVENTORY_NONE when it does not exist.
llSetPayPrice(integer price, list quick_pay_buttons) Sets the amount preset in the pay dialog for this prim and the quick-pay button values. Use PAY_DEFAULT or PAY_HIDE for special behavior.
vector llGetCameraPos() Camera position of the avatar who granted camera permission.
rotation llGetCameraRot() Camera rotation of the avatar who granted camera permission.
llSetPrimURL(string url) Sets the web page address shown on the faces of the prim.
llRefreshPrimURL() Reloads the page displayed on the faces of the prim.
string llEscapeURL(string url) Percent-encodes url so it is safe inside a URL, for example a space becomes %20.
string llUnescapeURL(string url) Decodes a percent-encoded url, for example %20 becomes a space.
llMapDestination(string simname, vector pos, vector look_at) Opens the world map on region simname, marking pos. look_at is ignored. Works only from attachments or during touch events.
llAddToLandBanList(key avatar, float hours) Bans avatar from the parcel for hours hours. 0 hours makes the ban permanent.
llRemoveFromLandPassList(key avatar) Takes avatar off the parcel's pass list.
llRemoveFromLandBanList(key avatar) Takes avatar off the parcel's ban list.
llSetCameraParams(list rules) Sets several scripted-camera settings at once; rules is a list of CAMERA_* parameters, each followed by its value.
llClearCameraParams() Restores every camera setting to its default and ends scripted camera control.
float llListStatistics(integer operation, list src) Computes a statistic over the numeric entries of src; operation is one of the LIST_STAT_* values.
integer llGetUnixTime() Seconds since 1 January 1970 00:00 UTC, read from the server clock.
integer llGetParcelFlags(vector pos) Bit mask of PARCEL_FLAG_* settings for the parcel containing pos.
integer llGetRegionFlags() Bit mask of REGION_FLAG_* settings for the region holding the object.
string llXorBase64StringsCorrect(string s1, string s2) XORs two Base64 strings and returns the result as Base64, repeating s2 when it is shorter than s1.
llHTTPRequest(string url, list parameters, string body) Sends an HTTP request to url with the given parameters list (HTTP_* options) and body. The answer arrives in the http_response event.
llResetLandBanList() Empties the parcel's ban list.
llResetLandPassList() Empties the parcel's pass list.
integer llGetObjectPrimCount(key object_id) Total number of prims in the object object_id, if it is in this region.
list llGetParcelPrimOwners(vector pos) List of owners of objects on the parcel at pos, each followed by how many prims they have there. The script owner needs owner-level rights over the parcel.

integer llGetParcelPrimCount(vector pos, integer category, integer sim_wide) How many prims are on the parcel at pos in the chosen category (a PARCEL_COUNT_* value: total, owner, group, other, selected, temporary). sim_wide counts the whole region instead of one parcel.
integer llGetParcelMaxPrims(vector pos, integer sim_wide) Largest number of prims the parcel at pos may hold. sim_wide gives the limit for the whole region instead.

list llGetParcelDetails(vector pos, list params) Reads properties of the parcel at pos. params lists PARCEL_DETAILS_* values (name, description, owner, group, area and so on) and the answers come back as a list in the same order.
llSetLinkPrimitiveParams(integer linknumber, list rules) Changes prim properties on the prim at linknumber; rules is a list of PRIM_* parameters, each followed by its values.
llSetLinkTexture(integer linknumber, string texture, integer face) Applies a texture to one face of the prim at linknumber.
string llStringTrim(string src, integer trim_type) Removes white space from src. trim_type is STRING_TRIM (both ends), STRING_TRIM_HEAD (start only) or STRING_TRIM_TAIL (end only).
llRegionSay(integer channel, string msg) Speaks msg on a nonzero channel to the whole region. Only scripts listening on that channel hear it.

list llGetObjectDetails(key id, list params) Reads properties of the object or avatar id. params lists OBJECT_* values (name, description, position, rotation, velocity, owner, group, creator and so on) and the answers come back as a list in the same order.
llSetClickAction(integer action) Chooses what happens when someone clicks the prim, using a CLICK_ACTION_* value.
integer llGetRegionAgentCount() Number of avatars currently in the region.
llTextBox(key avatar, string message, integer chat_channel) Opens a text entry window for avatar showing message. What they type is spoken on chat_channel.
string llGetAgentLanguage(key avatar) Language code of the interface language avatar has chosen.
vector llDetectedTouchUV(integer index) Texture (u, v) coordinates of the touch point, in the first two fields of the vector. Used in touch events.
integer llDetectedTouchFace(integer index) Index of the face that was touched. Used in touch events.
vector llDetectedTouchPos(integer index) Position of the touch point. Used in touch events.
vector llDetectedTouchNormal(integer index) Surface normal at the touch point. Used in touch events.
vector llDetectedTouchBinormal(integer index) Surface binormal at the touch point. Used in touch events.
vector llDetectedTouchST(integer index) Surface (s, t) coordinates of the touch point, in the first two fields of the vector. Used in touch events.
string llSHA1String(string src) SHA-1 hash of src, as 40 hexadecimal characters.
integer llGetFreeURLs() How many more URLs this script may obtain.
key llRequestURL() Asks for an HTTP URL that outside clients can use to reach this script. The result arrives in an http_request event.
key llRequestSecureURL() Asks for an HTTPS URL that outside clients can use to reach this script. The result arrives in an http_request event.
llReleaseURL(string url) Gives up url so that it stops working.
llHTTPResponse(key request_id, integer status, string body) Answers the incoming HTTP request request_id with the given status code and body.
string llGetHTTPHeader(key request_id, string header) Value of the header called header in the incoming HTTP request request_id.

integer llSetPrimMediaParams(integer face, list params) Adds media to a face, or changes it if present. params is a list of PRIM_MEDIA_* names each followed by a value; settings left out stay as they are, or take defaults for new media. Returns a STATUS_* code for the outcome.
integer llSetLinkMedia(integer linknumber, integer face, list params) Same as llSetPrimMediaParams but acts on the prim at linknumber. Returns a STATUS_* code for the outcome.

list llGetPrimMediaParams(integer face, list params) Reads media settings of a face. params lists the PRIM_MEDIA_* names wanted and values come back in that order. The list is empty when the face has no media.
list llGetLinkMedia(integer linknumber, integer face, list params) Same as llGetPrimMediaParams but acts on the prim at linknumber. The list is empty when the face has no media.
integer llClearPrimMedia(integer face) Removes the media and all its settings from a face. Returns a STATUS_* code for the outcome.
integer llClearLinkMedia(integer linknumber, integer face) Removes the media and all its settings from a face of the prim at linknumber. Returns a STATUS_* code for the outcome.
llSetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast(integer linknumber,list rules) Same as llSetLinkPrimitiveParams, but without the built-in delay after the call.
llGetLinkPrimitiveParams(integer linknumber,list rules) Reads prim properties of the prim at linknumber; rules lists the PRIM_* values wanted and the answers come back as a list.
llLinkParticleSystem(integer linknumber,list rules) Starts a particle emitter on the prim at linknumber, described by rules (PSYS_* parameter and value pairs). An empty list turns it off.

llSetLinkTextureAnim(integer link, integer mode, integer face, integer sizex, integer sizey, float start, float length, float rate) Starts, changes or stops a texture animation on one face or all faces of the prim at link. Other arguments work as in llSetTextureAnim.
integer llGetLinkNumberOfSides(integer link) Number of faces of the prim at link number link.
string llGetUsername(key id) Account user name of avatar id, or an empty string if that avatar is not in the region.
key llRequestUsername(key id) Asks for the account user name of avatar id. The answer arrives in the dataserver event.

string llGetDisplayName(key id) Display name of avatar id when it is already known to the region; otherwise the account user name. An empty string if the avatar is not in the region. Use llRequestDisplayName when the display name is required.
key llRequestDisplayName(key id) Asks for the display name of avatar id. The answer arrives in the dataserver event.
integer llSetRegionPos(vector v) Moves the object to v, a position in the region. Returns TRUE if the move was made.
integer iwGetLinkInventoryNumber(integer linknumber, integer type) Number of inventory items of the given type in the prim at linknumber.
integer iwGetLinkInventoryType(integer linknumber, string name) Type (an INVENTORY_* value) of the item name in the prim at linknumber.
integer iwGetLinkInventoryPermMask(integer linknumber, string item, integer mask) Permission mask of the given kind (MASK_*) for an inventory item of the prim at linknumber.

string iwGetLinkInventoryName(integer linknumber, integer type, integer number) Name of inventory item number of the given type in the prim at linknumber, counted from 0. Empty string when there is no such item.
key iwGetLinkInventoryKey(integer linknumber, string name) Asset UUID of the item name in the prim at linknumber.
key iwGetLinkInventoryCreator(integer linknumber, string item) UUID of the creator of an inventory item of the prim at linknumber.
string iwSHA256String(string src) SHA-256 hash of src, as a hexadecimal string.
void iwTeleportAgent(key agent, string region, vector pos, vector lookat) Teleports agent to pos in region, facing lookat, without asking them first.
key llAvatarOnLinkSitTarget() UUID of the avatar on the sit target of the prim at link number, or NULL_KEY when nobody is.
key iwGetLastOwner() UUID of the owner this object had before the current one.
iwRemoveLinkInventory(integer linknum, string item) Deletes the item named item from the inventory of the prim at linknum.
iwGiveLinkInventory(integer linknum, key target, string inventory) Copies an inventory item from the prim at linknum to target.

iwGiveLinkInventoryList(integer linknum, key target, string folder, list inventory) Copies the items named in inventory from the prim at linknum into a new folder called folder in the inventory of target.

key iwGetNotecardSegment(string name, integer line, integer startOffset, integer maxLength) Asks for part of line number line of the notecard name: maxLength characters starting at startOffset. The text comes back in the dataserver event.

key iwGetLinkNumberOfNotecardLines(integer linknumber, string name); Asks for the line count of the notecard name in the prim at linknumber. The count arrives in the dataserver event as text; the return value identifies the request.
key iwGetLinkNotecardLine(integer linknumber, string name, integer line); Asks for one line of the notecard name in the prim at linknumber. The text comes back in the dataserver event.

key iwGetLinkNotecardSegment(integer linknumber, string name, integer line, integer startOffset, integer maxLength); Asks for part of one line of a notecard in the prim at linknumber: maxLength characters starting at startOffset. The text comes back in the dataserver event.
integer iwActiveGroup(key agentId, key groupId) TRUE when avatar agentId is in this region and has groupId as the active group.
key iwAvatarOnLink(integer linknumber) UUID of the avatar seated on the prim at linknumber, or NULL_KEY. The prim does not need a sit target.

llRegionSayTo(key destination, integer channel, string msg) Speaks msg on a nonzero channel to destination only, anywhere in the region. Only a script of that recipient listening on that channel hears it.
integer llGetUsedMemory() Bytes of memory the script is using.
string iwGetLinkInventoryDesc(integer linknumber, string name); Description text of an inventory item in the prim at linknumber.
key llGenerateKey(); Creates and returns a new, unique UUID.
key iwGetLinkInventoryLastOwner(integer linknumber, string name); UUID of the owner an inventory item had before its current owner.
key iwRezObject(string inventory, vector pos, vector vel, rotation rot, integer param) Like llRezObject, but also returns the UUID of the newly created object.
key iwRezAtRoot(string inventory, vector pos, vector vel, rotation rot, integer param) Like llRezAtRoot, but also returns the UUID of the newly created object.

key iwRezPrim(list primParams, list particleSystem, list inventoryList, vector pos, vector vel, rotation rot, integer param) Creates a new prim from primParams and particleSystem settings, filled with the inventoryList items, at pos with velocity vel and rotation rot. Returns the UUID of the new object.
list llGetAgentList(integer scope, list options) List of up to 100 avatar UUIDs for the given scope (AGENT_LIST_*). options is not used; iwGetAgentList gives more control.

list iwGetAgentList(integer scope, vector minPos, vector maxPos, list params) List of up to 100 avatar entries for the given scope, limited to the box between minPos and maxPos. params picks the details returned for each avatar, as in llGetObjectDetails.
list iwGetWorldBoundingBox(key object) Bounding box of the object (all linked prims) in absolute world (grid-wide) coordinates, as the list [min corner, max corner].
integer llSetMemoryLimit(integer limit) Requests a new memory limit, in bytes, for the script. Phlox ignores the request.
integer llGetMemoryLimit() Memory limit of the script, in bytes. Phlox always reports 64K.

integer llManageEstateAccess(integer action, key avatar) Changes the estate's access lists: adds or removes an avatar on the allowed or banned list, or a group on the allowed-group list, depending on action (ESTATE_ACCESS_*). Returns TRUE on success and FALSE on failure.

integer iwSubStringIndex(string source, string pattern, integer offset, integer isCaseSensitive) Position in source where pattern first occurs at or after offset, counting from 0, or -1 when it does not occur. isCaseSensitive picks whether letter case matters.
llLinkSitTarget( integer link, vector offset, rotation rot ) Sets where a sitting avatar is placed on the prim at link, as an offset and rotation. An offset of <0,0,0> clears that sit target.
float llGetMassMKS() Mass in kilograms of the object the script is in.
float llGetObjectMass(key id) Mass in kilograms of the avatar or object id in this region.
iwSetGround(integer x1, integer y1, integer x2, integer y2, float height); Sets the terrain to height across the rectangle with corners (x1, y1) and (x2, y2).
llSetContentType( key request_id, integer content_type ); Sets the Content-Type of the reply to HTTP request request_id, using a CONTENT_TYPE_* value.

string llJsonGetValue( string json, list specifiers ); Reads the value found by following specifiers (a path of keys and indexes) inside json. Returns JSON_INVALID when the json is malformed or the path is missing, and JSON_NULL when the value is null.
string llJsonValueType( string json, list specifiers ); Type of the JSON value found by following specifiers inside json (a JSON_* constant).
string llJsonSetValue( string json, list specifiers, string value ); Returns a copy of json in which the value at the path specifiers is replaced by value.
string llList2Json( string type, list values ); Turns a list into JSON text: a JSON_OBJECT from key/value pairs or a JSON_ARRAY from plain entries, as chosen by type.
list llJson2List( string src ); Splits the top level of a JSON string into a list of its entries.
iwSetWind( integer type, vector offset, vector speed ); Sets, or clears, the wind speed at the given position in the region.

integer iwHasParcelPowers( integer groupPower ); Non-zero when the script owner holds the given group power (an IW_POWER_* value). IW_POWER_MANAGE_PASSES and the powers after it, up to IW_POWER_OBJECT_RETURN, must each be asked for in a separate call and cannot be joined with |. The earlier powers can be joined, and holding any one of them is enough.
vector iwGroundSurfaceNormal(vector offset) True surface normal of the terrain at the object's position shifted by offset.
key iwGetAnimationData(string name) Asks for details of an animation held in the prim's inventory. The answer comes back in the dataserver event, and the returned key identifies the request.

list llCastRay(vector start, vector end, list options) Traces a ray from start to end and reports what it hits. options is a list of RC_* settings. The result is a list of hits, each holding the UUID and position of what was hit and optionally more (link number and normal, depending on RC_DATA_FLAGS), followed by one integer: a negative error code, or else the number of hits returned.

llSetKeyframedMotion(list keyframes, list options) Moves the object along a list of keyframes (positions, rotations and times). The simulator interpolates smoothly between them. options holds KFM_* settings.
vector iwWind(vector offset) Wind velocity at the object's position shifted by offset. Unlike llWind, offset may include a height.
list llGetPhysicsMaterial() Physics settings of the object as the list [gravity multiplier, restitution, friction, density].
integer iwGetLocalTime() Current time as a Unix timestamp shifted to local time instead of UTC.
integer iwGetLocalTimeOffset() Seconds that local time is ahead of UTC (negative when behind), for example -28800 for UTC-8.

iwFormatTime(integer unixtime, integer isUTC, string format) Turns a Unix timestamp into text. isUTC says whether unixtime is already UTC (TRUE) or local time. An empty format gives a sortable form like 2013-12-31 23:59:08.

integer iwCheckRezError(vector offset, integer isTemp, integer landImpact) Tests, without rezzing anything, whether an object could be created at offset. isTemp says whether the object would be temporary (pass FALSE if unknown) and landImpact is its land impact if known (pass 0 to skip that check). Returns IW_REZ_OK, IW_REZ_NOT_PERMITTED, IW_REZ_REGION_SCENIC, IW_REZ_NO_LAND_PARCEL, IW_REZ_PARCEL_LAND_IMPACT or IW_REZ_REGION_LAND_IMPACT.

list iwParseString2List(string source, list separators, list spacers, list params) Extended llParseString2List: splits source at the strings in separators, keeps the strings in spacers as separate items, and params carries extra options that change the output.
integer iwChar2int(string source, integer index) Unicode code of the character at position index in source.
string iwInt2Char(integer num) One-character string for the Unicode code num.

string iwReplaceString(string source, string pattern, string replacement) Copy of source in which every occurrence of pattern is replaced by replacement. An empty replacement simply removes the matches.
string iwFormatString(string source, list values) Fills {0}, {1}, {2} and so on in source with the entries of values at those indexes, converting each entry to text. The entries may be of any type.
string iwMatchString(string source, string pattern, integer matchType) Checks source against pattern using the comparison chosen by matchType (an IW_MATCH_* value) and returns the outcome.

string iwStringCodec(string source, string codec, integer operation, list extraParams); Encodes (operation 1) or decodes (operation 0) source with the named codec. extraParams holds any extra settings a codec needs. Returns an empty string if the operation fails.

string iwMatchList(list list1, list list2, integer matchType); Compares list1 with list2 according to matchType: 0 requires the lists to be equal, 1 tests whether list1 starts with list2, 2 tests whether list1 ends with list2.

vector iwRGBColorToHSL(vector input, int color1, int color2); Converts the color vector input from the color space color1 to the color space color2. Each is IW_COLORSPACE_RGB, IW_COLORSPACE_HSL or IW_COLORSPACE_HSV.
vector iwNameToColor(string name); Color vector for a color name written without spaces.

integer iwVerifyType(string str, integer type); Works out what kind of value the text str holds and returns TYPE_INTEGER, TYPE_FLOAT, TYPE_VECTOR, TYPE_ROTATION or TYPE_KEY, or TYPE_STRING when it is none of those.

iwGroupInvite(key group, key user, string role) Invites user to group with the role named role. An empty role name means the Everyone role. An unknown user, group or role reports an error and nothing happens.
iwGroupEject(key group, key user) Removes user from group. An unknown user or group reports an error and nothing happens.

string iwGetAgentData(key id, integer data) Reads information (a DATA_* kind) about avatar id who is in the region. Unlike llRequestAgentData, the answer is returned directly instead of through an event.
integer iwIsPlusUser(key id) TRUE when avatar id has a paid Plus account.
llAttachToAvatarTemp(integer id) Attaches the object to the avatar at attach point id without putting it into the avatar's inventory.
integer iwListIncludesElements(list src, list elements, integer any) TRUE when src contains every item of elements. When any is TRUE, it is enough that src contains at least one of them.
string iwReverseString(string src); src with its characters in reverse order.
list iwReverseList(list src, integer stride); src with its entries in reverse order. With a stride above 1 the groups are reversed but the order inside each group is kept.
list iwSearchInventory(integer type, string pattern, integer matchtype); List of the items of the given type in this prim's inventory that match pattern. The comparison follows iwMatchString.

list iwSearchInventory(integer link, integer type, string pattern, integer matchtype); List of the items of the given type in the inventory of the prim at link that match pattern. The comparison follows iwMatchString.
integer iwIntRand(integer max); Random integer from 0 to max, both included.
integer iwIntRandRange(integer min, integer max); Random integer from min to max, both included.
float iwFrandRange(float min, float max); Random float from min to max.

list botSearchBotOutfits(string pattern, integer matchType, integer start, integer end); Like botGetBotOutfits, but only returns outfits whose names match pattern (compared as in iwMatchString). An empty pattern matches everything. start and end select a portion of the results.

list iwListRemoveElements(list src, list elements, integer count, integer mode); Returns src with occurrences of the entries of elements removed. When count is above 0, only that many occurrences are removed, starting from the front of the list.
list iwListRemoveDuplicates(list src); Copy of src that keeps only the last occurrence of each entry, so [1, 2, 1, 4, 2, 3, 4, -7] becomes [1, 2, 3, 4, -7].
iwStartLinkAnimation(integer link, string anim); Like llStartAnimation, but plays the animation anim taken from the prim at link number link.
iwStopLinkAnimation(integer link, string anim); Like llStopAnimation, but stops the animation anim taken from the prim at link number link.
integer iwClampInt(integer value, integer min, integer max); Returns value limited to the range from min to max.
float iwClampFloat(float value, float min, float max); Returns value limited to the range from min to max.

list iwSearchLinksByName(string pattern, integer matchType, integer linksOnly); Finds prims in the link set whose names match pattern (compared as in iwMatchString). Returns link number and name for each hit, or just the link numbers when linksOnly is TRUE.

list iwSearchLinksByDesc(string pattern, integer matchType, integer linksOnly); Finds prims in the link set whose descriptions match pattern (compared as in iwMatchString). Returns link number and description for each hit, or just the link numbers when linksOnly is TRUE.
integer botHasTag(key botID, string tag); TRUE when the bot botID carries the tag tag.
list botGetBotTags(key botID); List of all tags on the bot botID (possibly empty).

integer iwRemoteLoadScriptPin(key target, string name, integer pin, integer running, integer start_param); Functions same as llRemoteLoadScriptPin, but if the PIN doesn't match, then it returns an integer status code instead of shouting a debug message
integer iwValidateURL(string url); TRUE when url is well formed for the http, https or www forms.
integer iwDeliverInventory(integer linknumber, key destination, string inventory) Copies an inventory item from the prim at linknumber to destination and returns a code telling how it went.

integer iwDeliverInventoryList(integer linknumber, key target, string folder, list inventory) Copies the items named in inventory from the prim at linknumber into a new folder called folder in the inventory of target, and returns a code telling how it went.
list llGetAttachedList(key avatar) List of UUIDs of the attachments avatar is wearing that can be seen publicly.

integer llReturnObjectsByOwner(key owner, integer scope) Returns to their owners the objects of owner within scope (an OBJECT_RETURN_* value). Needs PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS, granted by the script owner or, for group-owned scripts, by a member of the group's Owners role. Result is the number of objects returned or an ERR_* code.

integer llReturnObjectsByID(integer linknumber, key target, string folder, list inventory) Returns the listed objects to their owners. Needs PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS, granted by the script owner or, for group-owned scripts, by a member of the group's Owners role. Result is the number of objects returned or an ERR_* code.

key llTransferLindenDollars(key destination, integer amount) Starts a payment of amount L$ from the script owner to destination and returns a key. The matching transaction_result event uses that key to report success or failure. A successful payment appears in the transaction history.

string iwGiveMoney(key destination, integer amount) Pays amount from the object owner's balance to destination and returns the transaction ID directly. On failure an error tag such as MISSING_PERMISSION_DEBIT is returned instead.
iwStandTarget(vector offset, rotation rot) Sets where, relative to this prim, an avatar is placed when it stands up from the prim.
iwLinkStandTarget(integer link, vector offset, rotation rot) Sets where, relative to the prim at link, an avatar is placed when it stands up from that prim.
string llGetAnimationOverride(string anim_state) Name of the animation currently used for the animation state anim_state.
void llSetAnimationOverride(string anim_state, string anim) Makes the animation anim play for the animation state anim_state.
void llResetAnimationOverride(string anim_state) Puts the animation for anim_state back to its default.
